# Forge native dnd5e 6 receiver fixtures

This snapshot contains three synthetic, unpersisted Actor/Item constructor inputs and outputs from Foundry Core 14.370 and dnd5e 6.0.6+local.3. It includes their project-authored workflow sources and canonical input/output hashes. It does not include existing world documents or users.

The replay checks the formal converter, summary projection, and closed response decoder against the captured native JSON shape, including nullable defaults and empty fields. It does not run the native constructors or establish broader Foundry gameplay compatibility.
